reviewed_violations.rationale: Reviewed legacy assertion transport coupling to SEGGER RTT; retained as explicit architecture debt until assertion transport is inverted.
Reviewed legacy logging transport coupling to SEGGER RTT; retained as explicit architecture debt until logging gains a downward-neutral transport interface.
Reviewed legacy message-bus dependency on the platform mutex API; retained as explicit architecture debt pending synchronization injection.
Reviewed legacy message-bus dependency on platform task notification APIs; retained as explicit architecture debt pending wakeup injection.

Reviewed: 06_utils depending DOWNWARD on 05_vender is sanctioned by docs/rules/structure.md, which names util_log and util_assert including SEGGER_RTT.h as the same shape. Reached only under UTIL_MATH_USE_CMSIS_DSP=1, which is 0 by default, so the default build has no vendor include here at all. Confined to this one shim header on purpose: the whole reason it exists is that util_kf and util_ahrs never name a vendor. These two dsp/ headers replaced a single arm_math.h include, which resolved to the WRONG package -- CubeMX installs two DSP versions and puts both on the path.
